description: Floor-length richly patterned plum court gown with low square neckline, structured bodice and elbow-length sleeves with small open shoulder sections. Gold geometric woven borders trace neckline, bodice edges, cuffs, center panel and hem. A cream linen underlayer shows in the lower walking opening. Jeweled round shoulder clasps, decorated girdle with red-purple central stone, matching drop earrings, bracelet and ring. A cream gold-edged wrap lies along the arms; patterned brown-gold flat shoes visible. No headgear, armor or weapons.
